name: Zenith Seeker's Testament
effects: Seven single ranged hybrid attacks (0.90 or 3.05 each) capped at 19999, Grants [Conditional Attach Element] based on entry element damage, [Damage Cap +10000], [Wisdom of Creation Mode], [Zenith Mode] and [Zenith Mode: Tyro] to the user

description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged hybrid attacks (0.90 or 3.05 each) capped at 19999, Grants [Conditional Attach Element] based on entry element damage, [Damage Cap +10000], [Wisdom of Creation Mode], [Zenith Mode] and [Zenith Mode: Tyro] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Tyro
description.text: Increases [Fire/Ice/Lightning/Earth/Wind/Water/Holy/Dark/Poison Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for elemental attacks, elemental abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Tyro after using a elemental ability (max 3), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Judgment Grimoire+
description.text: Three single ranged hybrid attacks (1.10 or 3.60)

description.name: Acicular Grimoire+
description.text: Five single ranged hybrid attacks (1.20/1.25 or 3.80/3.95) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Tyro
description.text: Four single hybrid ranged attacks (0.75 or 2.41 each), grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies, [Prismatic +30% Boost 1] to all allies ELEMENT IS SELECTED BASED ON if the user has Attach Fire/Ice/Lightning/Earth/Wind/Water/Holy/Dark/Poison

description.name: Conditional Attach Element
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning]/[Attach Earth]/[Attach Wind]/[Attach Water]/[Attach Holy]/[Attach Dark]/[Attach Poison]

description.name: Wisdom of Creation Mode
description.text: If the character hasn't any Infusion grants [Conditional Attach Element] after using an ability based on the ability's element

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
